properties.entry: SELECT ID_EMPLEADO FROM TAREA_EMPLEADO_ESTADO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY ID_EMPLEADO, OR_EMPLEADO, ID_TAREA HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN FROM TAREA_TIENDA_ESTADO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN, ID_TAREA HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN FROM TAREA_TIENDA_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN, ID_TAREA HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_EMPLEADO_ESTADO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea

SELECT * FROM TAREA_TIENDA_ESTADO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea AND ((CCL_ID_CADENA IS NULL OR CCL_ID_CADENA = '') OR (STD_ID_LEG_ENT IS NULL OR STD_ID_LEG_ENT = '') OR (STD_ID_COUNTRY IS NULL OR STD_ID_COUNTRY = '') OR (CCL_ID_ORIGEN IS NULL OR CCL_ID_ORIGEN = '') OR (CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN IS NULL OR CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN = '') OR (STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT IS NULL OR STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT = '') OR (ID_TAREA IS NULL) OR (ID_TIPO_TAREA_TIENDA IS NULL))

SELECT * FROM TAREA_EMPLEADO_ESTADO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea AND ((ID_EMPLEADO IS NULL OR ID_EMPLEADO = '') OR (ID_EMPLEADO_LOCAL IS NULL OR ID_EMPLEADO_LOCAL = '') OR (OR_EMPLEADO IS NULL OR OR_EMPLEADO = '') OR (ID_ESTADO_TAREA_EMPLEADO IS NULL ) OR (ID_TAREA IS NULL ))

SELECT * FROM TAREA_EMPLEADO_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea AND ((ID_EMPLEADO IS NULL OR ID_EMPLEADO = '') OR (ID_EMPLEADO_LOCAL IS NULL OR ID_EMPLEADO_LOCAL = '') OR (CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN IS NULL OR CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN = '') OR (STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT IS NULL OR STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT = '') OR (FECHA_FIN IS NULL ) OR (FECHA_INICIO IS NULL ) OR (OR_EMPLEADO IS NULL OR OR_EMPLEADO = '') OR (ID_TAREA IS NULL ))
